test_output_summary: All 80 unit tests in tests/unit/knowledge/test_student_model.py pass. Full repo test suite also green (150 passed in 6.37s, including the pre-existing TASK-GSM-002 episodes tests and the PydanticEntities seam test).
implementation_notes: Created src/study_tutor/knowledge/student_model.py with the seven Pydantic v2 BaseModel entity classes (Student, Subject, Text, Topic, AssessmentObjective, Misconception, TopicConfidence), the six relationship-name string constants (STUDIES, WORKING_ON, HAS_TEXT, COVERS, ASSESSED_BY, HAS_CONFIDENCE), and the three group-id constants (STUDENT_GROUP_PREFIX='student:', SUBJECT_GROUP_PREFIX='subject:', FLEET_GROUP_ID='fleet:appmilla'). Added confidence_band_for(percentage:int)->str helper using a descending-threshold table that maps 0-39->struggling, 40-69->developing, 70-89->secure, 90-100->mastered (raises ValueError on out-of-range). Module-level docstring documents the cross-repo divergence with specialist-agent ('appmilla-fleet') per ASSUM-008 and points back to phase-1-scope.md. All entities use ConfigDict(extra='forbid') so payloads are strictly typed before they reach Graphiti. The module is intentionally stack-agnostic (no graphiti-core import) per the IMPLEMENTATION-GUIDE §4 PydanticEntities contract; a regression test asserts this. No project-wide lint tool is configured in pyproject.toml or .claude/settings.json (default GuardKit template is language-agnostic), so AC-006 reduces to 'tests + import succeed', which they do.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Seven entity classes defined as `pydantic.BaseModel` subclasses with field types matching scope-doc tables
completion_promises.evidence: Defined Student, Subject, Text, Topic, AssessmentObjective, Misconception, TopicConfidence as Pydantic v2 BaseModel subclasses (via shared _StudentModelBase). Field types match the scope-doc tables in phase-1-scope.md §FEAT-PH1-001 and the TASK-GSM-001 scope (e.g. Topic.ao_refs is list[str], TopicConfidence.percentage is int with ge/le bounds, Text.kind is Literal['primary','secondary','context']). Tests parametrise over all seven classes asserting BaseModel inheritance, required-field validation, schema dump shape and round-trip equality.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Six relationship constants defined as string literals (`STUDIES`, `WORKING_ON`, `HAS_TEXT`, `COVERS`, `ASSESSED_BY`, `HAS_CONFIDENCE`)
completion_promises.evidence: Six module-level string constants exported with values matching their names. test_relationship_constants_match_scope_doc, test_relationship_constants_are_strings, and test_relationship_constants_are_distinct verify the values, types, and uniqueness.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Three group-id constants (`STUDENT_GROUP_PREFIX`, `SUBJECT_GROUP_PREFIX`, `FLEET_GROUP_ID`) exposed as module-level constants
completion_promises.evidence: STUDENT_GROUP_PREFIX='student:', SUBJECT_GROUP_PREFIX='subject:', FLEET_GROUP_ID='fleet:appmilla' all exposed at module scope and re-exported via __all__. test_group_id_constant_values asserts the exact values; test_group_id_prefixes_compose_to_expected_format checks the composition pattern (f'{STUDENT_GROUP_PREFIX}lilymay' == 'student:lilymay').

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] `confidence_band_for(percentage: int) -> str` helper returns the correct band per ASSUM-001 thresholds
completion_promises.evidence: confidence_band_for uses a descending-threshold table (90/70/40/0) so boundaries are exact: 0-39 struggling, 40-69 developing, 70-89 secure, 90-100 mastered. Tests cover all four boundaries (0,1,39,40,50,69,70,80,89,90,95,100), a full sweep over 0..100 to confirm closure under the four bands, and out-of-range rejection (-1, 101, 200, -100) raises ValueError. Return type is the ConfidenceBand Literal alias which Python treats as str.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Module docstring documents the cross-repo divergence: study-tutor uses `fleet:appmilla` per phase-1-scope.md (specialist-agent uses `appmilla-fleet` — see ASSUM-008)
completion_promises.evidence: The module docstring contains a dedicated 'Cross-repo divergence (per ASSUM-008)' paragraph that names both 'fleet:appmilla' and 'appmilla-fleet', cites phase-1-scope.md as the source convention, identifies specialist-agent as the sibling repo with the divergent convention, and warns against silent harmonisation. The FLEET_GROUP_ID constant has a matching inline NOTE that points back to the docstring. test_module_docstring_documents_cross_repo_divergence asserts all four required strings are present in __doc__.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: No ruff/black/flake8/isort tool configuration is declared in pyproject.toml (only [tool.hatch.*] and [tool.pytest.ini_options]) or .claude/settings.json (which is empty {}). The project is on the language-agnostic 'default' GuardKit template and quality-gates.md notes coverage/lint enforcement is opt-in for this template. With no project-configured lint, the criterion reduces to: source files compile and import cleanly, which is verified by the 80 student-model tests plus the cross-cutting suite (150 passed). test_student_model_module_does_not_import_graphiti_core also asserts the module is stack-agnostic per the §4 contract.
